<p>Similar to m_Specific, but the specific value to match is determined by another sub-pattern in the same <a href="#ac35245ebc6cb2872fc37ba3cb8919b8e">sd_match()</a> expression.</p>


<p>For instance, We cannot match <span class="doxyComputerOutput">(add V, V)</span> with <span class="doxyComputerOutput">m_Add(m_Value(X), m_Specific(X))</span> since <span class="doxyComputerOutput">X</span> is not initialized at the time it got copied into <span class="doxyComputerOutput">m_Specific</span>. Instead, we should use <span class="doxyComputerOutput">m_Add(m_Value(X), m_Deferred(X))</span>.</p>
